title: Event Staff Tools
description: This plugin aids staff while running events, it is compatible with mv core so staff can change what worlds are effected. It has features like disabling pvp, blocks and player movment.
body:
# Event Staff Tools
This pluginn assists Staff while running events, providing essential tools through one command.
![/es menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e8c0f6d5f82bc13c9af9b5efd2a5fb3853c3bb03.png)

Use perms:
```
es.admin
es.exempt
```

Commands:

./es - Open admin menu
./estaff - Open admin menu

**This plugin will always be free**
